summary: Draft update submitted from the run's draft directory: submission.json (validated read-only: valid, no diagnostics) plus the harness file assurance_generated_test.go. It registers one investigation into the leader-side ReadIndex producer under ReadOnlySafe, two sourced Behavior entries, and one experiment that drives a real 3-voter in-process cluster through the actual producer paths. Sourced mechanism: read_only.go:56-63 discards a MsgReadIndex whose rctx equals an already-pending one, raft.go:2142-2157 still re-broadcasts a heartbeat for it, and completion answers only the stored (first) request message (raft.go:1596-1606, 2068-2084); node.go:218-229 documents that lost ReadIndex requests are the caller's to retry and asserts reuse is supported from release-3.7, while rawnode.go:560-563 shows a dropped retry reports no error. The experiment compares, in one run, three scenarios with identical shape: equal rctx from two different voters, distinct rctxes (control), and one requester retrying its own rctx (control). Locally the harness passes and shows the duplicate-rctx second requester receiving zero responses and zero ReadStates over eight heartbeat rounds while the leader stays leader and the first requester is answered. No interpretation is claimed yet because the formal conclusion must cite the controller's retained execution receipt; the snapshot's own release-3.6 restriction is kept as counterevidence for human review.
